oracle.expected: Independent verification records a result that confirms the validator content against the frozen FR-3 source.
forbidden: Validator content is accepted without an independent verification result.
Verification only repeats the validator's own assertion without an independent check.
oracle.observable: A review artifact or validator output identifies the validator content, the independent check performed, and its pass/fail result.

acceptance.then: The independent verification result is present and traceable to the reviewed validator content.
acceptance.when: Run the independent validator-content verification command in the unit verification lane.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the validator-content verification assertion and fail when no independent result or only self-asserted content is observed。
Select the validator-content verification assertion and fail when no independent result or only self-asserted content is observed。

slice_hint.behavior_change: Add or maintain an independently verifiable validator-content check tied to FR-3; do not accept self-assertion as verification.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; reverting restores the prior validator-content verification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Pending independent verification -> recorded independent verification result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Unit validation observes a review/output artifact containing the validator identity, independent check, and result; otherwise fail.

acceptance.given: A matrix aggregate is evaluated from evidence records that include labels identifying their cases and evidence roles.

oracle.expected: When any matrix evidence label is incorrect, the aggregate status is invalid.
forbidden: An aggregate with mislabeled matrix evidence is marked valid.
The label error is ignored or normalized away.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluator returns an invalid status and exposes the mislabeled evidence diagnostic.

acceptance.then: The matrix aggregate is rejected as invalid and the label-mismatch diagnostic is observable.
acceptance.when: Execute the matrix aggregate validation in the unit verification lane with a deliberately mislabeled evidence record.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the matrix aggregate case containing a mislabeled evidence record and fail if aggregate validity is reported.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure matrix aggregation treats any incorrect evidence label as invalid and emits a diagnostic identifying the mismatch.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No schema migration; rollback restores prior aggregate classification behavior.

slice_hint.state_transition: Matrix evidence with correct labels -> mislabeled evidence -> invalid aggregate result.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Unit validation of a mislabeled matrix fixture observes aggregate status invalid with a label diagnostic.

acceptance.given: The compiled traceability graph contains Atomic Obligation nodes and linked assertion, selector, command, witness, and runtime-evidence nodes.

oracle.expected: Every Atomic Obligation has bidirectional Exact Cover links to each required node type, and every linked node resolves back to an Atomic Obligation.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation lacks a required link.
Coverage exists in only one direction.
Any assertion, selector, command, witness, or runtime-evidence node is orphaned.
oracle.observable: The Exact Cover validator emits a complete bidirectional coverage report with zero missing links and zero orphan nodes.

acceptance.then: The coverage report proves complete bidirectional Exact Cover with no orphan nodes.
acceptance.when: Run the Exact Cover graph validator in the unit verification lane against the compiled obligation graph.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select an Atomic Obligation graph case with a missing reverse link or orphan node and fail when the coverage report is not complete and bidirectional.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Preserve and verify bidirectional Exact Cover across assertions, selectors, commands, witnesses, and runtime evidence, including orphan detection.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema change; rollback restores prior graph-validation rules.

slice_hint.state_transition: Unverified traceability graph -> validated bidirectional Exact Cover report.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Unit Exact Cover validation reports zero missing reverse links and zero orphan nodes; any defect fails.

acceptance.given: A matrix success determination is evaluated for a case whose authority is foreign to the selected target package.

oracle.expected: The evaluator rejects success for the foreign-authority case and exposes a foreign-authority rejection diagnostic.
forbidden: Success is accepted for a foreign-authority case.
Foreign authority is treated as equivalent to the selected target authority.
oracle.observable: The success-determination result is a rejected-success outcome with a reason identifying the foreign authority.

acceptance.then: The foreign-authority case is rejected and cannot contribute a successful aggregate.
acceptance.when: Execute the success-determination check in the unit verification lane using a foreign-authority case fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Select the foreign-authority success-determination case and fail if the evaluator returns success or omits the authority-mismatch reason.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce target-authority binding during success determination so foreign-authority evidence is rejected.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted schema migration; rollback restores prior authority-binding decision logic.

slice_hint.state_transition: Foreign-authority case under evaluation -> rejected-success outcome.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Unit validation observes rejection with an authority-mismatch reason and no success contribution.
